sources.title: Cayman Islands Government, Cayman Islands 2026 Public Holidays (press release, 8 December 2025)
sources.said: The Cayman Islands Government has announced the official list of public holidays for 2026. Thursday, 1 January – New Year's Day; Monday, 26 January – National Heroes Day; Wednesday, 18 February – Ash Wednesday; Friday, 3 April – Good Friday; Monday, 6 April – Easter Monday; Monday, 4 May – Emancipation Day; Monday, 18 May – Discovery Day; Monday, 15 June – King’s Birthday; Monday, 6 July – Constitution Day; Monday, 9 November – Remembrance Day; Friday, 25 December – Christmas Day; Monday, 28 December – Boxing Day.

sources.title: Cayman Islands Government, Public Holidays
sources.said: Emancipation Day is observed on the first Monday in May ... Discovery Day is celebrated on the third Monday in May ... The Sovereign’s official birthday is observed in accordance with the provisions of the Public Holidays Act (2007), typically falling on the Monday following the date appointed in the United Kingdom. ... Cayman Thanksgiving is celebrated on the first Sunday in December. Whilst not a public holiday ...
